---
title: "The project"
---

::: {.prose}
GEMS is an **Open Science** project for brief cognitive assessment.
It started with the paper-and-pencil GEMS (2022) and grew into a family of tools for in-person, telephone and web-based screening.
The work is a collaboration between the University of Padua and IRCCS San Camillo Hospital in Venice, within the [NICLA group](https://nicla-group.github.io/).

## Open by design

All materials are released under Creative Commons licences and can be downloaded from each test's language page. They include record forms, instructions, scoring sheets, analysis code and Shiny apps for the cut-offs. See [Open & licences](open.qmd) for the licence of each test.

The complete set of files is also available in [one place on GitHub](https://github.com/giorgioarcara/gems-tests/releases/tag/materials-v1). These materials were originally published on the Open Science Framework (OSF projects 4t5a8, t3bma and fq8g7), which is no longer used.

## Translations and adaptations

Open materials make it easy to translate GEMS and collect normative data in other countries.
Each test on this site has one page per language, marked by a flag. New languages are added as translations become available.

If you would like to translate, adapt or norm GEMS in your language, [contact us](contact.qmd). We are happy to support cross-cultural validation projects.
